# SCI-NOI v0.1 — Scientific-Owner ODQ-109 Approval

Decision identity: `SCI-NOI-ODQ-109`

Scientific owner: Grant Wilson

Decision date: `2026-08-29`

Status: approved plan-controlled persistence and regeneration policy

## Exact Owner Decision

The owner approved the proposed ODQ-109 disposition: admit persisted-ensemble,
compact deterministic-regeneration, and streaming-sufficient-statistic modes;
make the reduction plan choose and record the mode; prohibit silent fallback;
and preserve fail-closed member completion and honest audit/reconstruction
limitations in every mode.

## Authorized Modes

### Persisted ensemble

Every required completed realization product is retained with exact member,
ensemble, immutable parent, method, operator-state, assignment/design, domain,
support, response, lifecycle, and provenance identity.

### Compact deterministic regeneration

Realization payloads need not be retained when every member assignment and
scientific operator state can be reconstructed from immutable parents plus the
exact method and algorithm versions, frozen operator-state identity, canonical
coherence-unit ordering, finite-design identity, admitted membership,
assignment key/seed/counter configuration, and requested/effective/applied/
realized configuration.

The record states its reproducibility class. Byte-identical reproduction may
be claimed only when guaranteed. Otherwise the exact numerical reproducibility
contract and limitation are declared. Compact reconstruction shall not change
the design, parent, assignment, method, or operator state.

Dense sign streams, per-sample sign provenance, stored randomized timestreams,
and stored realization maps are not universally required when the compact
identity reconstructs the approved detector-level assignments and declared
scientific product exactly under its reproducibility contract.

### Streaming sufficient statistics

Members may be consumed transiently only when the retained state is
mathematically sufficient for every exact product and claim published. For the
initial conditional second moment this includes the exact design-weighted
accumulation, common-all-member availability/domain state, and every retained
design/dependence quantity needed for reported effective information and
estimator uncertainty or explicit unavailability.

The streaming record states what cannot later be reconstructed or recomputed,
including individual members, member diagnostics, alternative estimators,
covariance structures, projections, or other analyses not supported by the
retained statistics. It shall not claim a retained ensemble.

## Plan And Lifecycle Rules

The persistence mode is plan-controlled and recorded distinctly as requested,
effective, applied, and realized. No universal storage default is selected.
There is no silent fallback among modes. Failure to produce a plan-required
persisted product fails that product; intentionally transient generation under
an authorized plan is not a persistence failure.

ODQ-105A applies in every mode. Every admitted member must complete through the
declared frozen operator. Member non-persistence, regeneration, or streaming
cannot create a survivor ensemble. A member failure fails the complete GEN
ensemble for UNC; partial streaming accumulators are discarded or retained
only as failed diagnostic state and carry no UNC authority.

Exact immutable completion truth, admitted membership, mode realization, and
audit/reconstruction limitations remain recorded even when realization
payloads are not persisted.

## Claim Boundary

Persistence, compact regenerability, or sufficient-statistic availability
does not establish statistical adequacy, covariance completeness,
calibration, significance, implementation conformity, performance, readiness,
or production authorization. A retained statistic authorizes only the exact
products and claims for which it is mathematically sufficient.
